gml:Dictionary.gml:description: Codes naming a measure adopted to protect embedded steel reinforcement from corrosion, used for the value of the corrosionProtection property of diggs:Reinforcement. MEASURES ARE NORMALLY COMBINED, NOT CHOSEN SINGLY - the Jazera record specifies a cement type, a pozzolanic admixture, a water/binder limit, a binder minimum, a chloride limit and a waterproofing membrane together for one exposure class - which is why corrosionProtection is repeatable (widened at R10 from a single occurrence). Two provenances are distinguished in the entry descriptions: measures EVIDENCED by the Jazera project record (GBL-24136 Table 8B, per 70-TMSS-03 Rev. 02), and measures included as established practice but NOT evidenced there, which are flagged for SME review rather than presented as equally sourced. Note that increased_cover names the measure while the sibling diggs:Reinforcement/cover element carries its magnitude. BUILT AT R10; see docs/build/R10/NOTES.md.
gml:Dictionary.gml:name: DIGGS Reinforcement Corrosion Protection Codelist Definitions

diggs:Definition.gml:description: Additional depth of concrete over the steel beyond the structural minimum, as the primary barrier against chloride ingress and carbonation. The MAGNITUDE is carried by the sibling diggs:Reinforcement/cover element (a length); this code states that increased cover is the adopted protective measure, so the two are complementary rather than redundant. Established practice for protecting embedded steel; NOT evidenced in the Jazera record, included for completeness and flagged for SME review.
diggs:Definition.gml:name: Increased concrete cover

diggs:Definition.gml:description: Use of a cement selected for resistance to sulfate attack - ASTM Type V, or a Type I/II with a controlled tricalcium aluminate (C3A) content. Evidenced by the Jazera project record (GBL-24136, Table 8B, per 70-TMSS-03 Rev. 02).
diggs:Definition.gml:name: Sulfate-resisting cement

diggs:Definition.gml:description: Partial replacement of cement with a pozzolanic material - fly ash or silica fume - to reduce permeability and bind free lime, lowering both sulfate attack and chloride ingress. Evidenced by the Jazera project record (GBL-24136, Table 8B, per 70-TMSS-03 Rev. 02).
diggs:Definition.gml:name: Pozzolanic admixture

diggs:Definition.gml:description: A specified maximum water-to-binding-material ratio, lowering permeability so that aggressive ions penetrate more slowly. Evidenced by the Jazera project record (GBL-24136, Table 8B, per 70-TMSS-03 Rev. 02).
diggs:Definition.gml:name: Reduced water/binder ratio

diggs:Definition.gml:description: A specified minimum binding material content (cement plus pozzolanic materials), raising the concrete's chemical buffering capacity and reducing permeability. Evidenced by the Jazera project record (GBL-24136, Table 8B, per 70-TMSS-03 Rev. 02).
diggs:Definition.gml:name: Increased binder content

diggs:Definition.gml:description: A specified maximum chloride content of the concrete as placed, limiting the chloride available to depassivate the steel from the mix itself rather than from the ground. Evidenced by the Jazera project record (GBL-24136, Table 8B, per 70-TMSS-03 Rev. 02).
diggs:Definition.gml:name: Concrete chloride content limit

diggs:Definition.gml:description: A waterproofing membrane or coating applied to the concrete surface, separating the element from aggressive ground water. Evidenced by the Jazera project record (GBL-24136, Table 8B, per 70-TMSS-03 Rev. 02).
diggs:Definition.gml:name: Protective membrane or coating

diggs:Definition.gml:description: Steel reinforcement supplied with a fusion-bonded epoxy coating as a barrier against chloride-induced corrosion. Established practice for protecting embedded steel; NOT evidenced in the Jazera record, included for completeness and flagged for SME review.
diggs:Definition.gml:name: Epoxy-coated reinforcement

diggs:Definition.gml:description: Steel reinforcement hot-dip galvanized so that the zinc layer corrodes preferentially to the steel. Established practice for protecting embedded steel; NOT evidenced in the Jazera record, included for completeness and flagged for SME review.
diggs:Definition.gml:name: Galvanized reinforcement

diggs:Definition.gml:description: Reinforcement of a corrosion-resistant stainless grade, used where the exposure or the required service life makes coated carbon steel inadequate. Established practice for protecting embedded steel; NOT evidenced in the Jazera record, included for completeness and flagged for SME review.
diggs:Definition.gml:name: Stainless steel reinforcement

diggs:Definition.gml:description: A chemical admixture dosed into the concrete that raises the chloride threshold at which the steel depassivates, or slows the corrosion reaction once it begins. Established practice for protecting embedded steel; NOT evidenced in the Jazera record, included for completeness and flagged for SME review.
diggs:Definition.gml:name: Corrosion-inhibiting admixture

diggs:Definition.gml:description: An impressed-current or sacrificial-anode system holding the steel at a potential at which corrosion does not proceed. Established practice for protecting embedded steel; NOT evidenced in the Jazera record, included for completeness and flagged for SME review.
diggs:Definition.gml:name: Cathodic protection
